title: Time Complexity of Rasta Key Recovery
summary: The source identifies Rasta's systems as a target of algebraic analysis, but their required solving time remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine the time complexity of solving Rasta's non-linear Boolean key-recovery systems.

scope.domain: Algebraic cryptanalysis of Rasta's non-linear Boolean key-recovery systems.
parameters: the number of equations, as a broad measure of the nonlinear system size
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the required time complexity for solving the systems.
